about: Every sound the game needs (docs/SOUND.md 2). group: who voices it (reference: the foundation; world: what a player or a machine does at a place; air: atmosphere, weather, distant events, scares, music, story, children). status: pending (not voiced yet), voiced (rendered and audited), dropped (with a note). sources: where the need comes from (preset = SynthPresets, inline = a recipe in web/src, worktree = another engineer's in-flight work, spec = docs/design/game-spec-v2.md, new = the redesign). family: the voice file it lives in (reference group: set; others: chosen by their engineer).
